basic_info.description: Breathtaking Bay Views  Are just some of the features you will love about this home.  Enjoy easy living in this urban oasis at the foot of Telegraph Hill and a block from the Embarcadero.  This highly coveted and rarely available North facing 2bd/ 2ba condo offers a newly refreshed palette.  A formal entry graciously welcomes with views to the Bay as soon as you enter. 9'ceilings, generous bedrooms, spacious closets, wonderful living space with adjoining deck to watch the ships roll in. Views to Treasure Island, Richmond Bridge, Angel Island and peeks of Alcatraz.  Easy entertaining with convenient kitchen/dining/living. Enjoy alfresco mornings and nights and a fireplace for cozy evenings.  The primary suite offers a respite from the bustle of the City with ample sitting room, Juliet balcony to drink in the views, dressing area w double vanity and walls of closets and shower over tub.  The second bedroom with dazzling views and large walk-in closet can be used as a bedroom, office, den. The guest bath is conveniently across the hall.  This home comes with a storage closet on the same floor and 1 car parking.
